_doc: Parameter provenance registry (2026-10-14). Schema, kinds and tiers: audit/parameters.py. Checked by tests/test_parameter_registry.py. 'value' is the value this provenance was written for; a different applied value fails as stale.

backend/regime/regime_bayes.py::_REGIME_.source: Flip table on the 69-date repaired sector_posterior_history series: stateless 16 -> 8 bull/neutral flips at 0.70; read off the table as the knee, 'a choice, not a fit' (comment at regime_bayes.py:925).
backend/regime/regime_bayes.py::_REGIME_.engine: none (replay of the production posterior series, no backtest engine)

backend/weekly_report.py::REFERENCE_WEEK.source: Weekly report prior-week reference window, hand-set in the 2026-10-15 session: about 50 demo entries pooled at the week ending 10-02's 6 entered, short enough to stay near the current config. Report-only: no gate, size or exit reads it.

backend/scheduler.py::EOD_RETRY_MINUTES.source: Retry spacing for a failed EOD regime catch-up, hand-set 2026-10-16 (Niclas: retries before the open instead of trading on the previous posterior). With the launch at 08:20 ET and the 09:25 ET limit, 10 min gives the startup run plus up to 6 retries; the input fetch takes about 1.5 min, so retries do not overlap.

backend/backtest/engine_fast.py::REGIME_.source: Any share in (0, 0.1) gives LR 1.0 under _lr_ipo_cluster's int(share * 10) step, for every sector count; 1/n does not (n <= 10 gives 1.2). The engine has no historical EDGAR feed, so IPO is neutral (floor_reconstruction.py precedent). Backtest-only: no live path reads it.

Ruled 2026-10-16 (engine port pre-work, design B): warm-up >= 30 sessions at decay 0.90, cold-start residual 0.9^30 ~ 4 %. A refusal floor: the timeline raises below it rather than run cold. Backtest-only.

backend/backtest/profit_metrics.py::TRAD.source: Annualisation convention for daily returns (NYSE sessions per year, the factor engine_fast._compute_metrics already uses as sqrt(252)). Report-only: no gate, size or exit reads it.

backend/backtest/live_shape.py::DAILY_LO.source: Niclas 2026-10-17: the engines' daily loss cap as live has it, 5 % of the starting balance (live $500 / $10,000, demo $100 / $2,000). Replaces config's $100 on a $10,000 simulation (1 %). Equity-based (5 % of current capital, Niclas's preference) is next Saturday's question.

backend/backtest/exit_rules.py::STOP_SLI.source: Measured 2026-10-17 on 44 filled sell-stop legs of the Alpaca paper account (2026-07-07..10-16): fill vs the engine's modelled price (stop, or the open on a gap through it). Intraday n 37 median -0.02 % mean +0.05 %; gap at the open n 7 median -0.50 % mean -0.13 %. Median, adverse side. Niclas 10-17: 'stop slip, modellera den från mätningen'; fees ignored.
